title: 第269章 论道第268章 真人
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
望月真人将手中茶盏放下，那双深不见底的眼在陶潜面上打了个转，笑道：“道友快人快语，贫道也就不绕弯子了。替劣徒道谢是其一，其二么，贫道观道友气象不凡，周身道韵圆融，隐有与天地合一之势，心中好奇，故而想来请教一二。”
陶潜将那根木拐棍轻轻在身侧立好，也放下茶盏，做了个请的手势：“道友但说无妨。”
望月真人身子微微前倾，压低了声音问道：“贫道斗胆，敢问一句，不知云笈道友证得这地仙果位，已有多少春秋？”
陶潜闻言，面上神色不变，只将那双浑浊老眼望向窗外灰蒙蒙的天色，半晌方才回道：“贫道资质愚钝，于那春秋之时方才侥幸得道，算来至今，已六百载有余矣。”
此言一出，望月真人端着茶盏的手便在半空中停住了。他脸上那份古井无波的神情霎时散去，换上了一副惊诧之色，将陶潜又重新打量了一遍，似乎要从他那干瘦的皮囊下瞧出什么究竟来。
“六百载……”望月真人喃喃自语，随即摇头苦笑，将茶盏放回桌上，长叹一声，
“道友此言，着实叫贫道汗颜。贫道自商朝末年入道，修行至今已逾千年，也不过是个地仙果位。道友以六百年之功，竟已快要摸着那混元的门槛，这等天赋，当真是贫道生平仅见。与道友一比，我那千年光阴，倒像是虚度了。”
他这番话发自肺腑，地仙之境，虽可与天地同寿，却也有高下之分。他修行千年，道行深厚，自然看得出陶潜周身那股若有若无、即将圆满归一的气韵，分明是比自己还要高出一筹的境界。
陶潜听了这番恭维，只摆了摆手，口中道：“千年也好，五百年也罢，不过是光阴长短。你我既得长生，又何必计较这些年岁？皆是求道途中人罢了。”
说罢，又提起那紫砂壶，为望月真人续上茶水，那壶嘴倾下的茶汤，依旧是稳稳当当，一滴不洒。
望月真人将那紫砂茶盏顿在木桌上，长叹了一声，道：
“道友所言极是，山中无甲子，寒尽不知年。只是这‘长生’二字，到底还有个计较处。我等如今虽修成地仙，号称与天地同寿，实则不过是依附造化。
待到那一个混元劫数降下，乾坤倒转，日月无光，世界重归混沌轮回之时，我等这般与天地同齐的仙真，自然也要跟着天地一并归于虚无。这等长生，算不得真长生。
若想得个万劫不灭的金刚之体，脱出这生死樊笼，还需往上再进，入得那混元的境界才成。”
正说间，门槛外忽地探出半个小脑袋来。正是那人参精化作的小参，扎着两个冲天小髻，一身粗布衣裳，一双乌黑眼珠子骨碌碌地转，正趴在那木门边往里头瞧。这女娃娃生得着实讨喜，也不认生，自从得知陶潜已识破她的身份之后，便不再害怕。
陶潜见状，只把手一招，从桌上青瓷碟里拿了一块黏米糕，递了过去。小参双手接过，欢天喜地坐在门槛上，小口小口细细嚼那吃食，也不做声，安安静静伴在旁边。
那望月真人看在眼里，手中拂尘搭过臂弯，摇头又叹道：“这草木成精，虽得了几分灵气，到底不晓大道艰难。只可惜，我等地仙俱是修的太乙玄门。这千百年来，天心难测，造化弄人，竟无人能将得那混元道果，是以进境艰难，宛如盲人摸象。
道友虽以五百年之功修成地仙，天纵奇才，但想来这五百载皆在深山之中闭门清修，不怎么外出走动，不知那混元之境有多高险。像我等太乙玄门的修真之士，为寻大道机缘，皆要脚踏云履，四方云游，广结四海高人，访友论道。只有借着各家之长，彼此印证印证，方能得出些许堪破虚妄的经验罢了。”
这望月真人一番言语，说得字字恳切，句句在理。此时且看这斗室之中：
瑞气盘旋，祥云隐隐。炉中檀香生紫雾，壶内灵茗吐清芬。两个得道神仙，对坐这方寸之间；一双长生傲客，讲论那出世玄机。

陶潜安坐在竹椅上，听罢这一席长篇大论，心中早已澄明，不由得笑了一声，回道：
“道友费了这许多唇舌，贫道若是再听不明白，倒真成个愚夫了。道友今日降临寒山，想必不是单为了那三个徒弟道谢，分明是特地寻上门来，要与贫道论道的也。”
望月真人听了这话，抚掌大笑道：“道友果是明眼人，一语便道破了贫道的心机。不瞒道友，贫道自打瞧见那三个劣徒身上沾染的气象，便知此间必有高真。
今日特来拜访，正是要与道友坐下来盘桓些时日，互相印证印证这一身所学，论一论那混元的门径，不知尊意如何？”
陶潜点头应道：“自无不可。我等修持之士，闭门造车终是落了下乘。若能广结高明，集百家之所长，取长补短以修己身，实是一桩极好的事。道友既有此雅意，贫道敢不奉陪？”
那门槛上坐着的小参听见两人说话，虽是不懂甚么大道玄机，却也乖巧地不插嘴，只管捧着那块黏米糕细细嚼吃。
她生得眉眼弯弯，两颊微鼓，头顶上那两个冲天小髻随着咀嚼的动作一晃一晃，煞是惹人喜爱。
望月真人看了一眼那女娃娃，忽地敛了笑容，正色道：“道友且慢，咱们这论道之举，还须先做个万全的计较。我观道友这鬼谷山中，所收的几百个弟子大多是肉体凡胎的普通人，未曾脱去凡骨。
你我这般境界，若真个开讲大道，剖析玄机，一旦入了定境，少说也要数十个寒暑方能收科。道友若不预先安排个章程，安顿好这些门徒，只怕数十年过去，这山中早已人事全非，倒误了他们的性命与前程。”
论道有长有短，短的只需几个时辰，但长的却是要数十年，甚至更有甚者数百年也不为过，故而需要做些准备。

content_en:
Master Wangyue put down the tea cup in his hand, his bottomless eyes turned around on Tao Qian's face, and said with a smile: "Fellow Taoist speaks quickly, and Pindao won't beat around the bush. Saying thank you to the bad disciple is one of the first, and the other is, Taoist Taoist of Pindao Temple has an extraordinary appearance, the Taoist rhythm around his body is harmonious, and he has the potential to be one with the heaven and earth. I am curious, so I want to come and ask for advice."
Tao Qian gently placed the wooden walking stick by his side, put down the tea cup, and made a gesture of invitation: "Fellow Taoist, it doesn't matter if you say so."
Master Wangyue leaned forward slightly, lowered his voice and asked: "I dare you to ask, how long has it been since Taoist Yunji attained the status of the Earth Immortal Fruit?"
When Tao Qian heard this, the expression on his face remained unchanged. He just looked out the window at the gray sky with his old muddy eyes. After a long while, he replied: "I am a poor Taoist with dull qualifications. I was lucky enough to gain Taoism in the Spring and Autumn Period. It has been more than six hundred years since then."
As soon as he said this, the hand holding the tea cup stopped in mid-air. The calm expression on his face instantly disappeared, replaced by a look of surprise, and he looked at Tao Qian again, as if to see something under his skinny skin.
"Six hundred years..." Master Wangyue murmured to himself, then shook his head and smiled bitterly, put the tea cup back on the table, and sighed.
"My fellow Taoist's words really put Pindao to shame. Pindao entered Taoism at the end of the Shang Dynasty and has been cultivating for more than a thousand years, but he is only an Earth Immortal. With six hundred years of hard work, fellow Taoist, I have almost touched the threshold of Hunyuan. This kind of talent is really the only one Pindao has seen in my life. Compared with fellow Taoist, my thousand years seem to have been wasted."
His words came from the bottom of his heart. In the realm of earthly immortals, although they can live as long as heaven and earth, they are still superior. He has practiced Buddhism for thousands of years and has a profound Taoist practice. Naturally, he can see that Tao Qian's vague aura that is about to return to perfection is clearly at a higher level than himself.
After hearing the compliment, Tao Qian just waved his hand and said: "Whether it's a thousand years or five hundred years, it's just a matter of time. Since you and I have immortality, why bother about these years? We are all just people on the way to seek the path."
After that, he picked up the purple clay pot again and refilled the tea for Master Wangyue. The tea soup pouring down from the spout was still steady and not a drop was spilled.
Master Wangyue put the purple sand tea cup on the wooden table, sighed, and said:
"What my fellow Taoist said is absolutely true. There are no armors in the mountains, and you don't know how old you are when it's cold. But the word 'immortality' still has a point of calculation. Although we have become earth immortals now and claim to live as long as heaven and earth, in fact we are just relying on nature.
When the catastrophe of Hunyuan comes, the world is reversed, the sun and the moon lose light, and the world returns to the cycle of chaos, we and other immortals who are aligned with heaven and earth will naturally follow the heaven and earth into nothingness. This kind of immortality is not really immortal.
If you want to obtain an immortal vajra body and escape from the cage of life and death, you still need to go up and enter the realm of Hunyuan. "
While he was talking, half a small head suddenly poked out from outside the threshold. It was the little ginseng made from ginseng essence, with two sky-high buns, a pair of coarse cloth clothes, and a pair of black eyes rolling around. He was lying next to the wooden door and looking inside. This female doll was really cute and didn't recognize her. Ever since she learned that Tao Qian had figured out her identity, she was no longer afraid.
Seeing this, Tao Qian took a piece of sticky rice cake from the celadon plate on the table and handed it over. Xiao Shen took it with both hands and sat happily on the threshold, chewing the food in small sips without making a sound, keeping her company quietly.
Master Wangyue saw this in his eyes, put the fly whisk in his hand on his arm, shook his head and sighed: "Although these plants and trees have become spirits, they have gained some spiritual energy, but they don't know that the road is difficult. It's a pity that we and other immortals have all cultivated the Taiyi Xuanmen. Over the past thousands of years, God's heart is unpredictable, and fate has played tricks on people. No one has been able to obtain the Hunyuan Dao Fruit. Therefore, it is difficult to enter, just like a blind man trying to grasp an elephant."
Although Taoist friends take fiveIt took a hundred years of cultivation to become an Earth Immortal, and he was a genius in the heavens. However, for the past five hundred years, he had been cultivating behind closed doors in the mountains and did not go out much. I don’t know how dangerous the realm of Hunyuan is. In order to seek opportunities for the great path, cultivators like us in Taiyi Xuanmen have to travel in all directions, make friends with experts from all over the world, and visit friends to discuss the Dao. Only by relying on the strengths of each family to confirm each other can we get some experience that can break the illusion. "
The words of Master Wangyue were sincere and every sentence made sense. Now let’s look inside this small room:
The auspicious air is swirling and the auspicious clouds are faint. The sandalwood in the furnace produces purple mist, and the tea in the pot emits clear fragrance. Two enlightened gods sit opposite each other within this square inch; a pair of immortal arrogants talk about the mysteries of the world.
Tao Qian was sitting on the bamboo chair. After listening to this long speech, his heart had already become clear. He couldn't help but laugh and replied:
"Fellow Taoist has spent so much time talking. If I don't understand this anymore, I will really become a fool. The fellow Taoist who came to Hanshan today must not have been just to express his gratitude to the three disciples. He was clearly looking for someone who came to discuss the Tao with the poor Taoist. "
After hearing this, Master Wangyue put his hands on his hands and laughed and said: "My Taoist friend is indeed a discerning person, and he can reveal Pindao's scheming with just one word. To be honest with you fellow Taoist, since I saw the atmosphere of those three scoundrels, I knew that there must be high truth here.
I came here to visit you today just because I want to sit down and spend some time with my Taoist friends to confirm each other’s knowledge and discuss the path to Hunyuan. What do you think of it? "
Tao Qian nodded and said, "It's okay. We practitioners, working behind closed doors, end up falling behind. It would be a great thing to be able to gather a wide range of talents, gather the strengths of hundreds of schools of thought, and learn from each other's strengths to improve one's own body. Since my fellow Taoist has such an elegant intention, how dare I refuse to accompany you? "
Xiao Shen, who was sitting on the threshold, heard the two talking. Although she didn't understand the secrets of the road, she obediently didn't interrupt and just held the piece of sticky rice cake and chewed it carefully.
Her eyebrows are curved, her cheeks are slightly bulging, and the two sky-high buns on her head sway as she chews, which is really endearing.
Master Wangyue glanced at the female doll, suddenly suppressed his smile, and said sternly: "Fellow Taoist, wait a minute, we need to make a thorough calculation before discussing Taoism. I observe that most of the hundreds of disciples accepted in Guigu Mountain, fellow Taoist, are ordinary people with mortal bodies, and have never shed their mortal bones.
If you and I are in a state where we can really teach the truth and analyze mysteries, once we enter the state of concentration, it will take at least dozens of winters and summers before we can complete the subject. If fellow Taoists do not arrange a charter in advance to settle these disciples, I am afraid that in the past few decades, the people in this mountain will have been completely changed, which will ruin their lives and future. "
There are long and short ways to discuss the Tao. The short ones only take a few hours, but the long ones take decades, or even hundreds of years. Therefore, some preparation is needed.
